description: Source code implementing MAPE (Mapping of Address and Port) configuration for WAN management, including tunnel setup, PSID calculation, and syscfg management.

methods.name: WanManager_MAPEConfiguration
methods.description: Configures MAPE tunnel, calculates PSID, sets syscfg parameters, and restarts firewall components.

methods.name: WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid
methods.description: Calculates PSID and IPv4 suffix based on IPv6 prefix and EA bits.

methods.name: WanManager_MAPE_ResetSyscfgDefaults
methods.description: Unsets syscfg parameters related to MAPE configuration defaults.
